title: Improving X-Ray Baggage Instance Segmentation with Shared Point-Based Mask Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.20476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Overlapping projections and complex object contours make prohibited items difficult to delineate in X-ray baggage images. This study investigates shared point-based mask refinement to improve instance segmentation within Cascade Mask R-CNN. The framework combines a ResNet-101 backbone with an attention-based feature pyramid and progressively updates uncertain mask locations, increasing mask resolution from $28 \times 28$ to $112 \times 112$. A single refinement module is shared across cascade stages and refinement levels, with transformer and multilayer perceptron (MLP) variants used to examine the role of interactions among selected points. Ten configurations were evaluated on the official PIXray split across three training seeds using the original target-instance annotations for evaluation. The transformer and MLP refiners achieved mean mask average precision (AP) of 71.79 and 72.47, respectively, compared with 70.50 for the unrefine

translated_title: 基于共享点式掩码精化改进X射线行李图像实例分割
translated_abstract: X射线行李图像中的投影重叠和复杂物体轮廓使得违禁物品难以精确勾勒。本研究探讨了在Cascade Mask R-CNN中采用基于共享点的掩码精化来改进实例分割。该框架将ResNet-101骨干网络与基于注意力的特征金字塔相结合，逐步更新不确定的掩码位置，将掩码分辨率从28×28提升至112×112。单个精化模块在级联阶段和精化层级之间共享，并通过Transformer和多层感知机（MLP）两种变体来考察所选点之间交互作用的影响。研究在官方PIXray数据划分上使用原始目标实例标注进行评估，并在三个训练随机种子下评估了十种配置。Transformer和MLP精化器分别取得了71.79和72.47的平均掩码平均精度（AP），相比之下未精化版本为70.50。
tldr: 该研究提出在Cascade Mask R-CNN中引入一个跨级联阶段与精化层级共享的点式掩码精化模块（含Transformer和MLP两种变体），逐步将掩码分辨率从28×28提升至112×112，在PIXray数据集上显著提升了X射线行李图像中违禁物品实例分割的平均掩码AP。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a shared point-based mask refinement module (with Transformer and MLP variants) in Cascade Mask R-CNN that progressively updates uncertain mask locations from 28×28 to 112×112 resolution, improving mean mask AP for prohibited item instance segmentation on the PIXray dataset.
